safety_classes.A: Full bleed: photos/video/archive/texture/large illustration/road/map/background objects; no central containment
safety_classes.B: Text safe: actual glyph runs must remain in canvas and outside hard UI masks
safety_classes.C: Semantic object: measure explicitly authored focal anchors/regions, not complete object bounding box
